title: RDDAC Teaser
subtitle: Real Deep Drawing and Cutting (RDDAC) Dataset
description:
A ~174 MB sample of the RDDAC dataset: 18 physical deep-drawing and cutting experiments (one per parameter category) with press force signals, sheet-thickness and oil-film traverses, and high-resolution 3D laser scans, plus the Croissant 1.1 manifest, the process parameter table for all 9,000 experiments, and the dataset documentation PDF.

RDDAC is the experimental counterpart to the DDACS simulation dataset (https://doi.org/10.18419/DARUS-4801): same cup geometry, same DP600 steel, same two-stage process — use it to quantify the simulation-to-reality gap or train models on real process data.

The full release (9,000 experiments, roughly 87 GB of lossless HDF5, with a predefined 7,200 / 900 / 900 train, validation and test split) is hosted on DaRUS with a citable DOI: https://doi.org/10.18419/DARUS-5589

Quickstart:

    pip install rddac
    import rddac
    with rddac.open_h5(0, data_dir='data') as f:
        force = f['force/data'][:]

Runnable tutorials are in the Code tab. Docs: https://rddac.readthedocs.io  Package: https://pypi.org/project/rddac  Source: https://github.com/BaumSebastian/RDDAC

License: data CC BY 4.0, code MIT. Please cite the dataset DOI and the paper (10.1007/s12666-026-03870-5).

resources.description: Overview, quickstart, and links to the full dataset, docs, and package.
Dataset documentation: overview, citation, and pointers to the schema reference and examples.

Croissant 1.1 manifest: the machine readable schema (every HDF5 field and CSV column) that rddac.load and mlcroissant consume. Its contentUrls point to DaRUS, so tools can fetch the full data on demand.
18 complete experiments, one per parameter category: press force signals, sheet-thickness and oil-film traverses, and the OP10/OP20 3D laser scans.
The process parameters plus split metadata for all 9,000 experiments.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Unique experiment identifier; matches the HDF5 filename (e.g. index=42 -> 0042.h5).

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: Base part geometry: concave or convex.

fields.name: blankholder_force
fields.description: Blank holder force applied during deep drawing, in kN. One of 100, 300, 500.

fields.name: oil_type
fields.description: Lubrication pattern applied to the blank: coarse, medium, or fine.

fields.name: experiment_id
fields.description: Repetition index (1..500) within one geometry x blankholder_force x oil_type category.

fields.name: mean_punch_temp
fields.description: Mean punch temperature recorded during the experiment, in degC.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Categorical index 0..17 encoding the geometry x blankholder_force x oil_type combination.

fields.name: has_pointcloud
fields.description: True if OP10/OP20 3D point-cloud scans are available for this experiment.

fields.name: has_oil
fields.description: True if the blank was lubricated (oil applied) for this experiment.

fields.name: split
fields.description: Recommended ML split: train (~80%), val (~10%), test (~10%); deterministic, seed 42.
